# Minarro Labs repository instructions

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the primary working policy for this repository and read
`docs/ai-review.md` for the Minarro Labs multi-perspective review contract.

The operator should not need special prompt syntax. For meaningful requests,
apply the technical, commercial, user, product, quality, security, design and
simplification lenses proportionately and synthesize them into one useful
recommendation or implementation direction.

For user-facing work, apply the product design baseline from
`.agents/skills/product-design/SKILL.md`: task clarity, visual hierarchy,
consistent components, responsive behaviour, accessibility and complete UI
states are part of done.

Do not generate eight repetitive role-play sections by default. Surface concrete
blockers first, then important improvements. Prefer the smallest solution that
preserves user/product value and security/correctness.
